jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.jd: [OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here ). [OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. [OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit. [AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here ) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it. Join us as an AI Engineer in our AI Products team to make sure the AI agents we ship are as reliable as they are fast to build. You'll design the evals, observability and tooling that keep agent quality high in a regulated bank. ➡️ What you'll do Build agents: You'll develop agents that take real actions for customers. Match rigor to risk: You'll size evaluation to the stakes, because an agent making transfers is not a PR bot. Own evaluation of every feature: You'll make sure every new agent capability comes with the right evaluation strategy, defining what needs to be tested offline and validated online, based on business requirements, expected outcomes and risk. Observe agents in production: You'll build the monitoring strategy that makes agent behaviour visible, tracks performance against business objectives and flags issues early. Scale it as a platform: You'll turn our tools, evaluation practices and monitoring capabilities into a self-service platform that lets other teams build, evaluate and operate their own agents. ➡️ What we're looking for Evaluation mindset: You've evaluated models or LLM systems and know what makes a test misleading. Strong ML foundations: You understand the ML lifecycle, from training and iteration to evaluation and monitoring, and core concepts such as overfitting, generalization and cross-validation. LLM and agentic systems knowledge: You understand the fundamentals of LLMs (particularly the Transformer architecture) and the building blocks of agentic systems. You know how to optimize an agent's harness (prompts, tools, hooks and orchestration) to improve its reliability and performance. Builder instinct and backend comfort: You've built and shipped something used by real users, whether professionally, during an internship or as a side project. You're comfortable reading and writing backend code, working with APIs and integrating systems. AI-native curiosity: You follow developments in AI closely, experiment with new approaches on your own and use AI tools daily in your work. ➡️ What we can offer you A rare problem: You'll make AI agents trustworthy in a regulated bank, where quality is not optional. Hands-on coaching: You'll learn directly from Pierre-Jean, one of the AI engineers in the team. Room to grow: Your scope grows as the platform opens to more teams. Space to experiment: You'll work at the frontier of AI in a team that keeps experimentation at its core. ➡️ Your future manager Your manager will be Sophie Cornay , our Product Leader for AI Products. Her background? Sophie has led product teams in startups and established tech companies. What does she bring to the team? She gives engineers real ownership and space to experiment. ➡️ Our stack and practices Python and Pydantic-ai: Python is our baseline language, and Pydantic-ai is our agentic framework. AWS: We access our models through AWS. Grafana: We track usage and cost per sub-agent on it. GitHub and CI: Every agent change ships through a reviewed pull request. Braintrust: Evaluation and agent monitoring run on our self-hosted instance. [DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along. [HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here [DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. jobs.title: AI Engineer (all genders)
jobs.jd: heyData is building a compliance platform that guides companies — from 10-person startups to 400-person multi-entity organisations — step by step to audit-ready outcomes across ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR and more. Compliance is a knowledge and process problem, and AI is one of the most powerful tools we have to solve it. We're growing our AI team. As an AI Engineer (all genders) , you'll identify where AI can eliminate manual work, build the systems that make it happen, and own those systems end-to-end. You'll work directly with the other AI Engineers, Product, Engineering and our compliance experts to discover real problems and ship solutions. This is a builder role. Most of your time goes into shipping AI-powered features that customers and internal teams use, so infrastructure decisions need to be pragmatic today and extensible tomorrow. Your Mission Discover and define AI opportunities Work with the AI team, Product, the VP of Engineering, the Engineering Team Lead and compliance experts to identify pain points and manual workflows that AI can automate. Translate fuzzy problem descriptions into clear AI feature specs: what the system does, what data it needs, how success is measured. Push back when AI is not the right solution, and propose alternatives. Build and ship AI-powered features Design and implement AI features on foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral), customised with RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and fine-tuning where justified. Expose AI services as RESTful APIs consumed by the rest of the application (NestJS/VueJS stack on AWS EKS). Build data ingestion and transformation pipelines that feed AI systems with heyData 's internal data and customer data, handled in line with GDPR. Integrate AI agents and multi-step workflows where appropriate, using frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex pragmatically. Own the AI lifecycle Manage the full lifecycle of every AI system you build: development, deployment, monitoring, retraining. Set up CI/CD pipelines for AI models integrated into our existing AWS infrastructure. Monitor model quality in production: detect drift, evaluate output quality, trigger retraining when needed. Document your systems so the team can understand, operate and extend them. Experiment and measure Design and run AI/ML experiments with clear hypotheses, appropriate evaluation metrics and statistically sound interpretation. Communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders in plain language. Follow developments in model providers, tooling and evaluation frameworks, and bring relevant ones to the team. Your Profile Experience Around 10 years of software engineering experience, at least 3 years of it building and operating production AI/ML systems. Proven track record shipping LLM-powered features to real users. Hands-on experience with foundation model APIs: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Mistral. Familiarity with AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd: Life at UiPath The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? Your mission As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own the delivery of scoped customer implementations and help turn real-world business needs into production-grade agentic automation solutions . You’ll partner closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to design, build, integrate, and iterate on AI-enabled workflows, balancing speed, reliability, and maintainability. You’ll contribute practical field insights back to the organization, helping refine solution patterns, reusable assets, and implementation playbooks. Unlike traditional software engineers who build a single product for many customers, FDEs ship tailored solutions directly in customer environments, making the platform real for specific business processes and systems. You’ll operate with increasing independence, drive execution on well-defined workstreams , and collaborate with senior FDEs and product teams to align with broader technical direction. What you'll do at UiPath Design and build AI-driven workflows, agents, and automations, aligned with UiPath's architecture and platform standards without requiring regular guidance. Build AI Agents using UiPath technologies, including Maestro or Agent Builder Apply practical prompt engineering skills to reliably guide agent behavior and understand model tradeoffs (capability, latency, cost) when selecting LLM providers for customer use cases. Extend platform functionality using APIs, SDKs, and connectors to address unique customer requirements. Debug across systems including AI inference, data pipelines, orchestration layers, and integration points, resolving most issues independently. Contribute to internal libraries, reusable components, or frameworks that enhance consistency across customer deployments. Anticipate delivery risks and communicate blockers, delays, and scope issues proactively to teammates and stakeholders. Use telemetry, insights, and traces to identify optimization opportunities and failure patterns independently. What you'll bring to the team 5+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent) delivering production software. Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (or similar modern languages). Experience building and shipping integrations using APIs and working with cloud services or enterprise systems. Comfort operating in customer-facing environments with strong written and verbal communication. Ability to independently drive scoped projects, manage risks, and deliver against deadlines. Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed. Our core principles Customer Centric: Stay close to customer users and stakeholders; anchor decisions in outcomes, adoption, and long-term success. Breaking Silos: Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customer teams to unblock delivery and align on the right solution. Improving Agility: Prototype, test, ship, observe, and iterate—treat deployments and feedback loops as the fastest way to learn. Dealing with Ambiguity: Make progress with incomplete information; clarify requirements through discovery, iteration, and pragmatic tradeoffs. Building Focus: Prioritize the highest-impact workstreams, manage scope actively, and deliver durable solutions that customers can run and evolve. Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Take part in day-to-day workflows with business functions to ensure prompt and high-quality data movement from source systems to production. Follow security, privacy and data governance guidelines (including GDPR) in everything you build. What you bring 1-2 years of experience with a focus on data lake and cloud infrastructure, with an interest in GenAI (RAG, agents or LLM-integrated apps). Hands-on exposure to building data pipelines in cloud environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, or GCP). Databricks experience is a plus. Good working knowledge of SQL and Python or another programming language to develop custom automation scripts, tables, and solutions. You should be comfortable using AI-native IDEs like Cursor/claude code to accelerate development and refactoring. Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible). An affinity for machine learning engineering or an intention to further develop skills in this area. Experience with data warehousing concepts and platforms like Snowflake, Google BigQuery. A basic understanding of financial concepts and an interest in helping finance colleagues adopt self-service tools. Why Prosus? You will be the technical authority embedded with our most complex customers, guiding them through deployment, architecture, onboarding, and the adoption of agentic development workflows. You bring deep hands-on experience from prior roles and use that depth to advise, design repeatable patterns, and drive customer outcomes end to end. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: About the role This is a hands-on senior role. You will write the core code, set the engineering standard for how we build agents, and work directly with clients to turn their workflows into acceptance criteria an agent can be tested against. If you have shipped a LangGraph system to production and can walk us through what broke and how you fixed it, we want to talk to you. What you'll build The runtime Design and build reusable agent runtimes in Python on LangGraph and LangChain, with clean interfaces for models, tools, memory, and integrations. Build stateful workflows with conditional routing, parallel branches, subgraphs, and human approval steps. Add multiple agents only when evaluation results justify the complexity. Reliability Implement durable checkpointing, pause and resume, timeouts, and cancellation. Make retries safe with idempotency keys, deduplication, and reconciliation when the outcome of an external action is unknown. Tools, context, and memory Build tool integrations with validated schemas, scoped permissions, authentication, and structured error handling across enterprise APIs and data systems. Engineer context and memory: retrieval, summarization, context selection, token budgets, retention, and tenant isolation. Evaluation and observability Build evaluation datasets and automated checks for business outcomes, tool-use correctness, policy compliance, and recovery, allowing for valid alternative execution paths. Gate every model, prompt, tool, and graph change on regression results. Instrument agents with LangSmith or equivalent tracing, then use traces to improve task success, latency, and cost per completed workflow. Security Implement prompt-injection defenses, authorization checks, secrets handling, audit trails, and approval controls for sensitive actions. Sandbox code execution where required. Delivery and leadership Own production delivery with backend and platform teams: APIs, streaming, containers, CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, and runbooks. Review code, mentor engineers, and translate client workflows into testable acceptance criteria. What you bring 8+ years of software engineering , including owning production systems from design through operation and hands-on AI/ML application work. 2+ years building LLM applications with LangChain , and at least one LangGraph system you shipped and ran in production. You can explain its architecture, how it failed, how you evaluated it, and what improved. Deep LangGraph knowledge: state schemas, reducers, nodes and edges, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointers, interrupts, and persistence. Fluent in current LangChain APIs for tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, and middleware. Agent harness experience: extending Deep Agents or a comparable harness, including middleware, planning, subagents, filesystem access, and sandboxed execution. Model Context Protocol (MCP): building and securing MCP tool servers, integrated with enterprise identity and access controls. Retrieval engineering: permission-aware RAG, hybrid search, reranking, and retrieval evaluation. Strong Python: async, typing, testing, API design, and maintainable service architecture. Backend and distributed-systems fundamentals: PostgreSQL, queues, concurrency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling. Real experience with LLM failure modes: unreliable tool calls, context limits, nondeterminism, rate limits, and regressions after model or prompt changes. You have used evals and traces to find and fix them. Observability: OpenTelemetry instrumentation alongside LangSmith or equivalent agent tracing. Cloud delivery: Docker, automated testing, and CI/CD on AWS, GCP, or Azure. AI-native development: you work in an AI-enabled software development lifecycle, using coding agents for design, implementation, testing, and review, with the judgment to verify their output and the habits to make a team faster with them. Clear communication: you can explain tradeoffs to engineers and clients and own delivery without close supervision. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd: Job Role: Forward Deployed Engineer – LLM / GenAI Experience: 5–10 Years Location: Bengaluru (Remote) Notice Period: Immediate to 15 days preferred Role Overview We are looking for a highly motivated and technically strong Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) with expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), modern data platforms, and technical consulting. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical implementation, working directly with clients to identify AI opportunities, define solution architecture, develop rapid prototypes, and drive end-to-end delivery of enterprise AI and data solutions. This role requires a combination of technical understanding, client engagement, solution consulting, and delivery ownership. While production-level coding is not mandatory, the candidate must possess sufficient technical expertise to evaluate solutions, review engineering deliverables, and guide implementation teams. Key Responsibilities Lead client discovery sessions and requirement-gathering workshops independently. Understand business challenges and translate them into scalable AI, GenAI, and data solutions. Define solution scope, technical requirements, architecture, deliverables, and implementation roadmaps. Collaborate with AI engineers, data engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver enterprise solutions. Develop rapid prototypes, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and demonstrations using AI platforms and tools. Evaluate LLM, RAG, and AI Agent solutions for accuracy, scalability, performance, and business relevance. Review data models, architecture diagrams, API specifications, and technical deliverables. Prepare Statements of Work (SOWs), project proposals, technical specifications, and delivery plans. Present technical solutions and recommendations to senior business and technology stakeholders. Take end-to-end ownership of delivery outcomes, ensuring quality, timelines, and customer satisfaction. Identify technical risks, dependencies, and implementation challenges and recommend appropriate solutions. Manage multiple client engagements and workstreams in a fast-paced, pod-based delivery environment. Ensure solutions align with enterprise security, governance, compliance, and cost optimization standards. Mandatory Technical Skills Strong understanding of Generative AI, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs). Working knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI Agents. Strong understanding of modern data platforms, data lakes, data lakehouse architecture, data pipelines, and data transformation. Understanding of end-to-end data flow from source systems to AI models and applications. Knowledge of cloud architecture and AI/data services on AWS and/or Azure. Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent enterprise data platforms. Understanding of API design, REST APIs, microservices, and enterprise system integrations. Ability to interpret data models, technical architecture diagrams, and API specifications. Experience using AI platforms and tools for rapid prototyping and client demonstrations. Understanding of MLOps, CI/CD, model registry, model deployment, and model observability. Knowledge of data security, AI governance, scalability, and cloud cost optimization. Delivery and Client Management Skills 5–10 years of experience in AI/data product delivery, technical consulting, or software/data engineering. Proven experience independently leading client discovery and requirement-gathering sessions. Strong client-facing, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Experience preparing SOWs, technical proposals, solution documents, and project specifications. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly solutions. Demonstrated experience owning delivery outcomes rather than simply coordinating tasks. Ability to work independently in ambiguous and rapidly evolving environments. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making capabilities. Ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities simultaneously. Good-to-Have Skills Experience in consulting, professional services, or forward-deployed/embedded engineering delivery models. Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Exposure to Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI APIs, or Google Vertex AI. Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar AI orchestration frameworks. Understanding of Agentic AI and multi-agent architectures. Knowledge of Data Mesh and enterprise data governance frameworks. Experience with LLM evaluation, hallucination detection, AI guardrails, and responsible AI practices. Previous experience in AI solution consulting or technical pre-sales. Key Skills Generative AI | LLM | RAG | Agentic AI | AI Agents | Technical Consulting | Solution Architecture | AWS | Azure | GCP | Snowflake | Databricks | Data Engineering | Data Lakehouse | Data Mesh | API Integration | MLOps | CI/CD | AI Governance | Client Management | SOW | Proof of Concept | Delivery Management Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd: We are building the first AI-native platform for automated product compliance in MedTech . REMATIQ turn hundreds of page of complex regulations (like MDR and FDA guidance) into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers’ development and quality processes. The result: life‑saving medical devices reach patients faster and safer. About the job As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you build software with and for our customers. Existing customers ask for more than the standard product does. They want further use cases, integrations with their own systems and workflows specific to their organisation. You sit with the customer's team, scope the problem and build the solution end to end. It runs at the customer as custom software or becomes a feature of the REMATIQ web app. This is a software engineering role with customer contact, not a consulting role. You work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product and the platform team. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week. How you'll contribute Scope with the customer: Sit with their project team and subject-matter experts, understand the workflow and its constraints, and cut the problem into something that can ship in weeks. Build and ship end to end: Design, develop and deploy the solution, including backend services, integrations, AI workflows and the interface it needs. Run what you shipped: Operate it in production, fix what breaks, and be the customer's technical contact for it. Build integrations: Connect REMATIQ to the systems customers already use in their development and quality processes. Move custom work into the product: Build features in the web app and work with the platform team to turn one customer's solution into a product capability. Find the next use case: Spot further use cases while you work with the customer and scope them together with Delivery. Our stack We work in a modern TypeScript‑first monorepo: Core: Node.js 20+, TypeScript 5+, pnpm workspaces, Turborepo. Frontend: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, and design system. Backend & workflows: Express-based services, with DBOS for durable workflows. Data & storage: PostgreSQL with pgvector, Prisma ORM, Azure Blob Storage. AI & observability: Azure OpenAI, Langfuse, Sentry, plus logging/tracing with tools like Winston and OpenTelemetry. Dev experience: AI‑assisted workflows with Cursor and Claude Code, integrated into our TypeScript‑first monorepo and review process. What you'll bring We are looking for a software engineer who ships production software and is equally at home in a customer's meeting room. You may be a strong fit if you have: Relevant background: 3+ years as a software engineer shipping production software, ideally including forward deployed, solutions engineering or other customer-facing engineering work. Product management or team lead experience: Some experience as a product manager or team lead, where you owned scope, priorities and requirements for what is being built, is a strong plus. Strong TypeScript and Node.js backend experience: You build and operate production services and can contribute to React frontends where needed. Solid database fundamentals: PostgreSQL (ideally), including data modelling, migrations and performance. Integration experience: You have connected a product to enterprise systems through APIs, SSO or data exchange, and have worked within a customer's IT and security constraints. Experience building with LLMs: You have put LLM-driven features into production and know how to make them predictable and reviewable. Strong customer presence: You scope a problem with non-technical stakeholders, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and manage expectations without a project manager next to you. AI-native working style: You use Claude Code or Cursor every day to move faster without compromising reliability. High ownership: You take an ambiguous customer problem to production with limited guidance. Willingness to travel: You work on site at customers when the project needs it. Fluency in English (mandatory). German is a strong plus. We'll be especially excited if you Have worked as a forward deployed or customer-embedded engineer Have built software for a regulated industry such as MedTech or pharma. Have been a founder or a very early engineer at a startup. Why this is a great opportunity Impact in a high-stakes domain – Work on compliance workflows in one of the most regulated industries, where correctness and traceability matter and the outcomes are real. Bring GenAI into production – Build the systems that make LLM-driven features predictable, auditable, and reliable in safety-critical MedTech environments. Real ownership – Own major parts of our platform and drive architectural decisions across backend services, workflows, and data. AI‑agent‑first development – Build in an environment where tools like Cursor and Claude Code are first‑class citizens, helping you explore designs, refactor, and ship faster while you stay in control of quality and reliability. Strong peers – Work with people who care deeply about craft and outcomes, in a high-ownership culture that includes teammates with founder experience. Work with leading MedTech companies – Build products used by teams at BBraun, Novartis & Bayer. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Multi-Modal Agents)
jobs.jd: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in training and optimizing multimodal agents with a focus on real-world, interactive deployment. Your work will span the full agent development lifecycle - from data curation, interactive sandbox environments, and training pipeline design to model evaluation and optimization - with the goal of building multimodal agentic models that are both highly capable and practical to deploy locally at scale. You will work across a wide spectrum of multimodal architectures integrating perception, reasoning, and tool execution across digital environments, applying state-of-the-art research to improve visual grounding, multi-step task completion, and adaptability to unseen interfaces. We expect you to bring a research-driven mindset combined with strong engineering discipline - someone who can identify the right technique for a given problem, implement it rigorously, and measure its impact clearly. You will work closely with a small, high-caliber team where your contributions will have direct and meaningful impact. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what multimodal agentic AI can achieve in production environments, this is your opportunity. Responsibilities Conduct end-to-end research and engineering on multimodal agentic models capable of perceiving, reasoning, and acting across real-world digital environments - including desktop operating systems, web browsers, and mobile devices. Design and scale post-training and online reinforcement learning pipelines (SFT, multi-turn GRPO/PPO) across multi-node GPU infrastructure, covering asynchronous rollouts, reward design, deterministic/learned verifiers, and safeguards against reward hacking. Architect high-concurrency interactive sandboxes (VMs, containers, and emulators) with fast snapshotting, deterministic resets, and reproducible evaluation frameworks to measure multi-step task completion and visual grounding. Build and optimize local agentic harnesses that coordinate multi-model orchestration, memory, planning, and cross-device task execution. Research and implement test-time adaptation and continual learning methods to enable rapid generalization to unseen applications and dynamic user interfaces. Develop scalable multimodal agentic datasets, including synthetic trajectory generation, fine-grained UI grounding, and automated trajectory filtering and verification. Drive model efficiency and local deployability on consumer hardware via knowledge distillation, quantization, and runtime optimization without degrading grounding or reasoning accuracy. Translate frontier multimodal agentic research into production improvements, contribute to open-source ecosystems, and publish findings in top-tier AI conferences where applicable. Requirements Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (MS/PhD preferred), or equivalent practical research and engineering experience. Strong hands-on experience training or post-training multimodal/vision-language models (SFT, distillation, or online RL such as GRPO/PPO) with measurable gains on agentic, visual grounding, or reasoning benchmarks. Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and distributed training or high-throughput rollout/inference infrastructure (e.g., FSDP/Megatron, Slurm, verl, vLLM/SGLang). Deep hands-on in one or more of: online agentic RL & verifiers, high-concurrency OS/browser/mobile sandboxing, local agentic harnesses or test-time adaptation. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly state

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will build software that runs on real drones. You will take Auterion’s platform into a specific customer program and make it work on their hardware, for their mission, in the field.

This is a software engineering role. You will design, write, integrate and debug C++ and Python code on a Linux-based autonomy stack, working with AuterionOS, our operating system for autonomous vehicles, and Skynode, our flight and mission computer running PX4 and AuterionOS. Your work will span autonomy, computer vision, video streaming and long-range radio links, on partner platforms across aerial, maritime and ground vehicles. What sets this role apart is that your work isn’t finished when the code is merged; it’s finished when the system flies.

You will join a forward deployed team dedicated to a single customer program, which owns the outcome from first requirement to deployed system. You will work directly with partners and customers, as well as with Auterion’s core platform, hardware and flight test teams. Between trips, you will work from our Munich office, both at your desk and on the bench.

No drone experience is required. If you have integrated software on cars, robots, industrial machines or other embedded systems, you already have the right foundation, and we will teach you the drone side.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design and implement software for customer programs on AuterionOS and Skynode, including features, integrations, payload and sensor drivers, and tooling.
  • Bring up complete systems on real hardware, including compute, sensors, payloads and radios, and get them working end to end.
  • Debug across the full stack, determining whether an issue stems from software, configuration, hardware or RF, and then resolving it.
  • Translate customer mission requirements into technical solutions and working demonstrations.
  • Work on site with partners and customers to run flight tests, trials and demonstrations, solving problems directly in the field.
  • Deploy software releases to customer systems, including flashing, configuration and calibration.
  • Report field learnings back to core engineering in a form they can act on, and help shape the product roadmap with real customer input.
  • Document what you build so that future teams can repeat it.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software, Electrical, Robotics or Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Solid experience developing software in modern C++, plus Python for tooling, automation and data analysis
  • Strong Linux skills, including the command line, logs, Docker and networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Experience getting software running on embedded or physical systems, including comfort with UART, CAN, I2C and SPI, wiring, and using a multimeter on the bench
  • A structured approach to debugging and the ability to stay methodical under time pressure
  • Clear communication in English with customers, operators and engineers alike
  • Eligibility for German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink or QGroundControl
  • Experience with video pipelines, computer vision, or radio and datalink systems
  • Integration or field engineering experience in automotive, robotics or aerospace
  • Experience working with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Wellpass membership 

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

jobs.title: Data Scientist II, Selection Growth Science
jobs.jd: Join us in shaping the future of Amazon’s Selling Partner business. The Selling Partner Selection Success organization is the growth and development engine for Amazon’s Store. We partner with product, engineering, science, and business teams to help Selling Partners identify promising product opportunities, make informed launch decisions, and grow new selection successfully. We combine comprehensive data, machine learning, experimentation, and seller insights to deliver actionable guidance at scale. We believe every motivated Selling Partner should have access to the tools and resources needed to build a successful and sustainable business on Amazon. We are looking for a Data Scientist II to develop science solutions for supporting end-to-end new selection success. Our vision is to connect selection guidance with opportunity/ASIN prioritization across pre and post launch. These solutions help Selling Partners understand unmet customer needs, link various demand signals with supply signals, assess a product’s potential before committing resources, improve product and listing decisions, and reach relevant customers after launch. Maintaining consistency across these stages is essential for earning Selling Partner trust and creating a continuous feedback loop between our guidance and actual customer outcomes. In this role, you will develop models and analytical frameworks that combine customer demand, on/off supplies, product attributes, comparable-selection performance, seller and brand signals, and early customer engagement. You will estimate product potential and uncertainty across different lifecycle stages, identify new products that offer distinctive customer value, and determine where Amazon interventions can improve discovery and conversion. You will work with large-scale behavioral, catalog, seller, and external-selection datasets across multiple marketplaces. The successful candidate will combine strong statistical and machine learning foundations with sound business judgment. You will translate ambiguous business questions into measurable science problems, develop and evaluate scalable solutions, and work with engineering partners to move them into production. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.jd: Do you thrive on complex problems and want to work at the forefront of AI? Join Cefetra Group’s new AI Innovation Hub as an AI Engineer and shape how AI creates value across our international trading business, from agents and workflows integrated with our core systems to the skills and ways of working that make them stick. Who we are Cefetra Group comprises several trading companies in the agricultural sector and the food ingredients industry, with leading brands in the ingredients market. Together, we employ approximately 800 people across 39 offices in 17 countries worldwide. We work closely together to provide our customers with the best possible service. Together with our suppliers, we develop strong supply chains and create value by sourcing raw materials and supplying them to the international food, animal feed and energy industries. Behind that sits real complexity: global commodity flows, volatile markets, intricate contracts and logistics, and data spread across many entities and systems. That is exactly where AI can make a decisive difference, and we are building the capability to make it happen. The role As an AI Engineer in the AI Innovation Hub, part of the Group Digital & Technology team, your goal is to build Cefetra Group’s AI capability and set the standard for how AI is designed and used across our entities. You’ll deliver AI solutions, from agents and workflows to knowledge bases, that teams across Cefetra Group can apply to augment their work, while helping colleagues build the skills to use them. You’ll work directly with process owners and business leaders to find where AI creates the most value. The AI Innovation Hub is just getting started, so together with the Group Digital & Technology team you’ll shape its direction from the ground up: which opportunities it pursues and how it delivers them. You’ll also work with Builders and Changemakers, colleagues in our entities who build AI solutions and drive adoption, to share what works and show business leaders what AI makes possible. Your responsibilities include Run discovery workshops to identify bottlenecks, value and exceptions. Assess use cases against readiness, team commitment, expected value and reuse potential. Build AI workflows and agents using company data. Take prototypes all the way to robust, production-grade solutions that teams rely on in their daily work. Integrate AI solutions with ERP, finance and operations systems, designing integrations that move safely from read-only access to controlled write-back. Test solutions against real business scenarios. Set the deployment patterns, tool choices and safeguards that others across Cefetra Group build on. Deliver hands-on workshops, from practical AI topics such as Claude Skills for non-technical colleagues to technical topics such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Builders and create materials Changemakers can use to train their peers. Prepare demos of working use cases for leadership briefings. Who you are To succeed at Cefetra Group, you love complexity and combine deep technical curiosity with a pragmatic, collaborative approach. You work well both independently and with people at all levels of Cefetra Group. You take ownership end to end and move easily between governance, technical details and business priorities. You also meet the following requirements: You have at least four years of experience in a technical, customer-facing, consulting or product role. You’ve built and evaluated large language model (LLM) workflows, agents or applications in production. You have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, indexing, knowledge bases, context engineering and orchestration. You follow AI developments closely, from new models to agentic patterns and protocols, and know how to turn new capabilities into practical value. You have full-stack development experience with Python or TypeScript, including APIs, authentication, data transformation and enterprise integrations. You’re fluent in English and have led workshops for non-technical audiences. What we offer A unique opportunity to help Cefetra Group grow and become part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial team within an established multinational. We’re always open to discussing your individual needs. Here’s what we offer. Access to frontier AI models and the room to experiment with new tools, techniques and ways of working. Flexible working hours and hybrid working, as well as opportunities to learn and develop. An excellent remuneration and benefits package, including a competitive base salary, holiday allowance, an attractive bonus scheme and 28 days of annual leave. jobs.title: Master Thesis on Robust Agentic HEMS Control using Time-Series Foundation Models via MCP
jobs.jd: Modern Home Energy Management Systems (HEMS) face the challenge of translating complex user requests into concrete, dependable system actions. While state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) are advancing rapidly in reasoning, multi-modal comprehension, and tool usage, high-precision quantitative modeling of physical signals remains computationally demanding. Specialized Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) offer compelling complementary capabilities for modeling complex numerical curve dynamics, opening up exciting opportunities to explore where and how TSFMs can most effectively support LLM-driven agents. In this Master's thesis, you will research a robust, closed-loop agentic framework where an LLM agent interacts with specialized time-series foundation models via the standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP) to analyze, safeguard, and optimize HEMS operations. The thesis can emphasize one or more of the following research directions: Closed-Loop Control & Dynamic Forecasting: Interactive feedback loops for iterative parameter optimization and trajectory simulation. Anomaly Detection & System Guardrails: Real-time identification of abnormal consumption, device faults, and operational constraints. Data Quality & Smart Imputation: Generative zero-shot reconstruction of missing sensor time-series to ensure dependable downstream operation. During your 6-month thesis, your work will focus on the following key areas: During your assignment, you will connect a specialized Time-Series Foundation Model (TSFM) as an independent service to an existing LLM agent ecosystem using the standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP). You will investigate how numerical time-series outputs generated by the TSFM (predictions, reconstructed values, anomaly scores) can be mathematically abstracted at the server level into concise semantic representations tailored for LLM reasoning. Additionally, you will design an interactive evaluation loop where the agent proposes parameter actions, evaluates the model's simulated response or safety feedback, and converges on optimal, robust control decisions. Finally, you will systematically evaluate scenarios and data representations to determine where specialized TSFMs deliver measurable advantages over pure LLM reasoning in terms of computational efficiency, token consumption, latency, and predictive accuracy. Education: master studies in the field of Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or comparable with good grades Experience and Knowledge: strong proficiency in Python (especially familiarity with data and time-series processing libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, as well as modern asynchronous frameworks like asyncio); theoretical and practical grounding in machine learning (ideally time-series models / foundation models); solid understanding of modular software architectures and network interfaces Personality and Working Practice: you are highly self-motivated, using your strong analytical skills to drive independent scientific research Work Routine: we offer you the opportunity to work in a hybrid setup Enthusiasm: strong interest in agentic workflows, tool-calling mechanisms and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Language: very good in English or German Start: according to prior agreement Duration: 6 months Requirement for this thesis is the enrollment at university. Please attach your CV, transcript of records, examination regulations and if indicated a valid work and residence permit. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Growth Alliance (all genders)
jobs.jd:
At HelloFresh, the goal is to change the way people eat forever by delivering high-quality food across 18 countries and 3 continents. As a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit provider, the portfolio includes HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, and Youfoodz.

Engaging with HelloFresh in Warsaw means collaborating with HelloTech-a global technology division of over 1,000 people powering an end-to-end food ecosystem. From digital personalization, pricing, and forecasting to supply chain optimization and food waste reduction, technology drives every step of this direct-to-consumer model.

About the Role: What's in the Box

HelloTech operates in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each holding accountability for a specific product domain end to end. In this role, you will join an assigned squad, with the flexibility to transition between teams and projects as technical objectives and business priorities evolve.

Several high-impact machine learning domains are actively hiring, and your project and team placement will be aligned based on your individual strengths, interests, and expertise during the interview process. Key domains include:

  • Risk, Fraud & Payments (Growth Alliance): You will own production ML systems that protect HelloFresh from checkout fraud and intelligently recover failed recurring payments (such as Smart Payment Retry) via low-latency scoring on Databricks.
  • Personalization & Conversions (Growth Alliance): You will build real-time decisioning systems, customer win-back models, and scalable GenAI content pipelines that tailor journeys and messaging across visitor and customer funnels.
  • Dynamic Pricing & Customer Value Optimization (Growth Alliance): You will architect and scale the core Pricing Engine to drive pricing optimization and forecasting across 8 brands, 34 markets, and all weekly menus.

Across all domains, you will work on scalable, high-availability production ML systems serving global architectures. Please note that this is an individual contributor role and does not include people management responsibilities.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh, we are moving away from a model where engineers simply execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. As a Product Engineer, you will take a problem, form a point of view, validate it with customers and data, and ship it using AI as a force multiplier.

  • Build and operate data products and machine-learning systems, taking them from experimentation through production and owning their real-world performance.
  • Architect and optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines (Python, SQL, PySpark on Databricks, Kafka), feature stores, and low-latency serving infrastructure.
  • Improve inference performance, reliability, and compute cost by profiling bottlenecks, right-sizing infrastructure, and maintaining tight latency targets with dependable fallback mechanisms.
  • Establish and raise modern MLOps standards across teams, including CI/CD automation, model registry versioning, infrastructure as code (Terraform), automated validation gates, and drift detection.
  • Design and execute rigorous experimentation frameworks from A/B tests and holdouts to off-policy evaluation-to credibly measure model impact on core business metrics.
  • Build and scale domain-specific applied AI solutions, ranging from real-time scoring and contextual bandits to production GenAI pipelines with automated quality gates.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to pressure-test models for production readiness, mentor teammates, and leverage AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or Cursor) to accelerate engineering delivery.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

  • 5+ years building and operating live ML systems in production, paired with the statistical literacy to design sound experiments and interpret their results.
  • Hands-on experience building product-facing ML solutions directly tied to measurable business metrics (such as conversion, retention, revenue, or risk reduction).
  • Deep command of Python, SQL, and large-scale data processing (PySpark on Databricks), paired with solid software engineering practices (testing, clean code, version control) and familiarity with low-latency serving or backend languages like Go.
  • Hands-on background with cloud environments (AWS), containerization, automated CI/CD, and modern ML or orchestration tooling such as Databricks Model Serving, MLflow, SageMaker, Airflow, Kafka, or Terraform.
  • Practical, day-to-day fluency with AI coding tools (like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot) beyond casual experimentation—knowing how to structure context and set clear boundaries on AI-generated work.
  • A quality-first mindset around model evaluation, drift monitoring, and A/B testing pitfalls for ML systems to ensure bad data or outputs never reach customers.
  • A bias to ship ("finishing the last twenty percent"), strong product sense backed by data, and clear communication skills across international, multi-disciplinary teams.

Nice to have:

  • A track record of optimizing data and ML pipelines for performance and cost at scale.
  • Experience with contextual bandits and off-policy evaluation.
  • Hands-on experience building and running production LLM pipelines.
  • Background in churn prediction and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) modeling.
  • Prior experience in high-growth consumer tech or subscription-based businesses.

jobs.location: US, CA, Santa Clara US, Remote
jobs.jd: NVIDIA has helped redefine what computers can do. Now, generative AI is opening new possibilities for how people learn, create, and tackle problems. Realizing that potential means answering some of the hardest questions in AI: Where do models fall short? Which risks are we missing? How do we know our safeguards are working? As an expert in machine learning for Evaluations, you’ll help establish the evidence that guides the next generation of safer AI. Your curiosity and scientific judgment can shape what we test, what we learn, and what we build next. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer / AI Researcher / Data Scientist to join our AI Safety and Responsibility efforts within Enterprise Risk Management. Engaging directly in engineering tasks, you will apply your data science and statistics skills. You will turn open research questions into rigorous benchmarks, inventive experiments, and tools that reveal how multimodal large language models behave under pressure. Working with researchers and platform engineers, you’ll connect those discoveries to better training methods and safeguards, with reproducible results that inform technical reviews and executive decisions. If you love asking the question no one has thought to test, and building a convincing way to answer it, come help us define what progress in AI safety looks like. What You Will Be Doing: Safety Benchmarking: Design and maintain safety benchmarks for large language and multimodal models, translating risk scenarios into test cases, datasets, and scoring rubrics. Evaluation Methodology: Define metrics and protocols that assess safety alongside model usefulness, using baselines, uncertainty estimates, and failure analysis to distinguish meaningful improvements from noise. Reproducible Evaluation: Build reusable Python pipelines with versioned datasets, model configurations, and experiment tracking to reproduce results and compare performance across model releases. Automated Red-Teaming: Develop tools to discover failure modes and expand evaluation coverage, incorporating human review to validate automated scoring and provide additional judgment. Failure Analysis: Investigate model failures with researchers, document actionable findings, and develop regression tests to assess whether model changes resolve identified issues. Results and Communication: Partner with platform engineers to store and aggregate evaluation results, and clearly communicate findings, limitations, and emerging risks to researchers and decision-makers. What We Need To See: Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 6+ years in the field of machine learning engineering or evaluation. Evaluation Design: Experience developing benchmarks, metrics, and statistically sound comparisons for ML systems, including selecting baselines and interpreting uncertainty. Ability to translate ambiguous evaluation questions into testable experiments. Engineering: Strong Python skills and experience building maintainable shared tools, data pipelines, and experiment-tracking workflows. Analytical Rigor: Ability to assess dataset quality, identify limitations in metrics and scoring methods, and support conclusions with reproducible evidence. Communication: Clearly explain findings and tradeoffs to researchers, engineering partners, and executives. Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: Evaluation: Experience evaluating LLMs, multimodal models, or agentic systems through adversarial testing or automated red-teaming. Community Contributions: Contributions to public benchmarks or evaluation frameworks. Research Publications: A publication track record and interest in continuing to publish at top tier venues. Human-Aligned Evaluation: Experience validating model-based evaluators against human judgments or designing human-in-the-loop evaluation workflows. Statistical Rigor: Strong model evaluation skills and a commitment to sound statistical practices, including confidence intervals. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. jobs.jd:
DECATHLON DIGITAL 

L'entité Data de Decathlon coordonne l'ensemble des activités visant à l'accélération et la généralisation de l'usage et la valorisation des données.

Decathlon vise à devenir la meilleure plateforme digitale de sport et l'écosystème ouvert le plus performant au monde. Nous voulons permettre à nos clients de vivre l'expérience Decathlon à travers de nombreuses expériences locales centrées sur le sport en connectant de nombreux acteurs et services tiers, de manière sécurisée et performante.

Nos équipes digitales à Lille, Paris et Nantes - qui rassemblent plus de 5000 collaborateurs - sont unies pour construire et faire évoluer des produits digitaux avec l'objectif de toujours offrir la meilleure valeur à nos utilisateurs. Présent dans plus de 70 pays, Decathlon est engagé dans l'innovation, la durabilité et la satisfaction des clients.

Tu participeras à des projets qui ont le potentiel de définir l'avenir du sport : une vraie opportunité de façonner l'industrie grâce aux données et à l'IA !

Pour renforcer nos équipes Data & IA, nous recrutons un(e) Stagiaire Data Scientist - Computer Vision pour un stage de fin d'études conventionné de 6 mois, à partir de février 2027, basé à Paris.

LE SUJET DE STAGE

Dans un environnement retail en constante évolution, l'analyse visuelle en magasin représente un levier majeur pour optimiser l'excellence opérationnelle et mieux comprendre l'expérience client.

Au sein de nos équipes Data & IA, ton objectif sera de concevoir et prototyper des solutions innovantes basées sur la vision par ordinateur en exploitant différents flux visuels (images et vidéos), dans le strict respect des normes de confidentialité (RGPD).

L'enjeu : allier recherche algorithmique de pointe et impact concret sur le terrain, à travers des cas d'usage variés tels que l'analyse automatisée des rayons (détection de ruptures, conformité de mise en rayon) et la compréhension des parcours en magasin (estimation de pose, cartes de chaleur).

TES RESPONSABILITÉS

Tu interviendras sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur du projet, de la recherche appliquée jusqu'à la démonstration de valeur :

  • Veille et état de l'art scientifique : Explorer et évaluer les dernières approches en Computer Vision (détection d'objets, segmentation, estimation de pose, modèles de fondation visuels).
  • Détection et analyse de rayons : Développer des algorithmes de détection d'objets, de segmentation et de classification pour analyser les photos de linéaires (identification d'articles, détection de ruptures visuelles, conformité de mise en rayon et supports de communication).
  • Analyse de flux et estimation de pose : Prototyper des modèles d'estimation de pose pour modéliser les dynamiques et parcours en magasin, tout en garantissant le strict respect du RGPD.
  • Exploration de données et entraînement : Préparer des jeux de données complexes (images et vidéos) et entraîner ou adapter des modèles de l'état de l'art (ex. YOLO, ViT, modèles de fondation, MediaPipe).
  • Collaboration et valorisation : Restituer tes avancées et résultats à travers des visualisations et des démonstrations (PoC) auprès des équipes techniques et métiers.

Le périmètre technique :

  • Python, SQL
  • PyTorch ou TensorFlow, OpenCV, modèles & librairies de Computer Vision (ex. YOLO, ViT, Foundation Models, MediaPipe)
  • Databricks, Spark, dbt
  • Airflow (Astronomer), AWS (S3, ECR, ...)
  • Jupyter, Git, Docker

CE DONT TU AURAS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou en Master 2 spécialisé en Computer Vision, Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou équivalent, à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois.
  • Socle technique : Tu maîtrises Python, SQL et Git, et tu possèdes de solides bases en Machine Learning, Deep Learning (PyTorch ou TensorFlow) et Computer Vision (ex. OpenCV, YOLO, ViT).
  • Communication : Tu as d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, analytiques et de présentation, avec la capacité de vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes de manière simple pour des équipes métiers.
  • État d'esprit : Tu aimes explorer et résoudre des problèmes, clarifier proactivement les besoins, travailler en autonomie et prendre des responsabilités lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Culture : Tu es sensible à l'impact de la pratique du sport et tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif (#Tech4Good).
  • Cerise sur le gâteau : Tu as déjà travaillé sur des problématiques liées au retail ou manipulé des datasets complexes d'images/vidéos en environnement réel.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

  • Un environnement de travail moderne dans nos bureaux Decathlon Digital à Paris
  • La possibilité d’innover et d’avoir de l’impact grâce à la data et à la technologie
  • Liberté de choix de l'outil de travail (Mac, Windows)
  • Une équipe projet locale connectée à un réseau international
  • Montée en compétences et mentorat (diversité de projets, technologies de pointe, certifications, événements)
  • Formations internes et externes
  • Gratification de stage et possibilité de pré-embauche selon opportunités

jobs.jd: If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/ About Us Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day. We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process. About the Role We're looking for a data scientist with strong statistics and modeling skills to be the science partner for the machine learning and recommendation systems behind Twitch's discovery products. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. That means balancing what a viewer does today (a click, a play, minutes watched) against what keeps them coming back: return visits, daily habits, and lasting connections with creators. It also means weighing short-form clips against long-form live content, and each surface against the others. This role will draw from a variety of statistical learning techniques, causal inference, optimization and recommender systems evaluation, and it still owns the full path from question to decision. Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will work from our San Francisco, CA office. You Will - Help define the objective functions and success metrics for ranking and recommendations across feeds, search and notifications. Make the trade-offs explicit between short-term engagement (clicks, plays, watch time) and long-term outcomes (return visits, retention, new creator connections), including how short-form clips and live content add to or take away from each other. - Evaluate ranking, recommendation and feed changes with ML engineers and applied scientists. This covers A/B tests and long-running holdouts, offline metrics that predict online results, and the cost and value of exploration and cold start. Handle the hard cases: novelty effects, interference between experiments, two-sided marketplace effects involving creators and viewers, and feedback loops in recommendation data. - Build statistical and ML models that explain viewer behavior and size opportunities, such as propensity, uplift, survival and retention models. Include proxy metrics that predict long-term retention, so teams can decide in days rather than months. - Turn ambiguous product questions into clear analyses. Quantify the uncertainty, and make recommendations that inform the machine learning and discovery roadmap. - Define the logging and data needed to measure discovery surfaces, and check its quality. - Contribute to the team's standards for experimentation, causal inference and model evaluation, and share what you learn with other data scientists. Perks - Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance - 401(k) - Maternity & Parental Leave - Flexible PTO - Amazon Employee Discount About the team Twitch is all about community, and our Community team is a core pillar of what makes Twitch, Twitch. Community Discovery & ML (CDML) helps millions of viewers find the creators and communities they'll love. That covers search, browse, the mobile live and clips feeds, recommended notifications, and the recommendation systems behind them. When a viewer finds a new creator through one of these, it's often the start of a lasting connection. That connection is what keeps viewers, and the creators they watch, coming back. - 3+ years of data scientist experience - A BA/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent industry experience. - 3+ years as a data scientist in a high-velocity, data-driven environment, with hands-on experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning (regression, classification, causal inference, time series), including the assumptions behind each method and when it fails. - Experience designing and analyzing online experiments, including variance reduction, power analysis and the pitfalls of interpreting results. - Expert SQL and proficiency in Python or R. - A track record of using data and models to influence product decisions and leadership. - An MS or PhD in a quantitative field. - Experience with recommender systems, search ranking or feed ranking, such as offline evaluation (precision and recall, NDCG), exploration versus exploitation, or cold-start problems. - Experience with multi-objective optimization or with defining objective functions for ranking systems, including choosing weights between competing goals. - Experience building proxy metrics for long-term outcomes, or estimating long-term effects from long-running holdouts or observational data (e.g., difference-in-differences, synthetic control, uplift modeling). - Experience with two-sided platforms or marketplaces, where changes for viewers also affect creators or supply. - Experience on a consumer content platform: streaming, short-form video, social or marketplaces. - Familiarity with Twitch, as a viewer or a creator (or both!).
